mxCell.value: INDEX: VehicleId, CustomerId, BranchId, Status, StartDate+EndDate

CORE BUSINESS AREA


- VEHICLES

Stores all vehicles available for rental. Includes identification data (RegistrationNumber), characteristics (Brand, Model, Year, Category), pricing (DailyRate), and status (Status, IsActive). Each vehicle is associated with a branch and the user who added it.

Index on: RegistrationNumber, Category, BranchId for fast filtering and lookup.



- CLIENTS

Represents customers who rent vehicles. Contains contact information and important flags such as IsFlagged (problematic customer) and IsActive.

Index on: Email, Phone, FullName for quick identification.



- RENTALS

The central table — links a client to a vehicle. Stores rental period (StartDate, EndDate), total cost, rental status, and optional cancellation reason. Also includes the users who created and completed the rental.

Think: who + what + when + where + handled by whom

Index on: VehicleId, CustomerId, BranchId, Status, StartDate, EndDate.



- BRANCHES

Represents physical locations (offices) of the company. Stores details such as city, address, and phone number. Optionally linked to a manager (ManagerId → User).

Role: central hub for vehicles, users, and rentals.

Index on: Name, City.

USER / OPERATIONS AREA


- USERS

Represents employees or system administrators (separate from Clients). Includes authentication data (Username, PasswordHash), role (Role), and security mechanisms (IsLocked, FailedLoginAttempts, LockedUntil). Can optionally belong to a branch.

Used for:

  • adding vehicles

  • creating/completing rentals

  • audit and security tracking

Index on: Username, Email, Role, BranchId.

AUTHENTICATION & SECURITY AREA


- REFRESHTOKENS

Manages user sessions (JWT refresh tokens). Each token belongs to a user and includes expiration and revocation (IsRevoked).

Index on: Token, UserId.


- SECURITYALERTS

Stores security alerts associated with users (e.g., suspicious login attempts). Includes alert type, description, and read status (IsRead).

Used for monitoring and incident response.

AUDIT AREA


- AUDITLOGS

Records all important actions performed in the system. Tracks affected entity (EntityType, EntityId), action type, details, timestamp, and the responsible user (nullable for system actions).

Think: who did what and when

 Index on: EntityType + EntityId, Timestamp, UserId.

KEY RELATIONSHIPS


RELATIONSHIP

TYPE

Rentals → VehiclesMany-to-One
Rentals → ClientsMany-to-One
Rentals → BranchesMany-to-One
Rentals → Users (CreatedBy / CompletedBy)Many-to-One
Vehicles → BranchesMany-to-One
Vehicles → Users (AddedBy)Many-to-One
Users → BranchesMany-to-One (optional)
Branches → Users (Manager)One-to-One (optional)
Users → RefreshTokensOne-to-Many
Users → SecurityAlertsOne-to-Many
Users → AuditLogsOne-to-Many (0..1)
